title: Quarterly access recertification
statement: System owners must recertify every user's access to their system once each quarter. An account that has not been used for sixty days is automatically suspended until its owner revalidates the need. Privileged accounts must use multi-factor authentication and must have a named individual owner.
summary: Access is recertified quarterly, dormant accounts suspend at sixty days, and privileged accounts need MFA and a named owner.

title: Confidentiality agreements before disclosure
statement: A mutual non-disclosure agreement must be signed before any confidential material is shared with a prospective partner. Only the standard company template may be used without Legal review. Any confidentiality term longer than three years requires sign-off from Legal.
summary: Sign a mutual NDA before sharing, use the standard template, and involve Legal for terms beyond three years.

title: Corporate card usage limits
statement: A corporate card purchase may not exceed £2,000 in a single transaction. Cash withdrawals on a corporate card are prohibited. Card statements must be reconciled with receipts within seven calendar days of month end.
summary: Corporate cards are capped at £2,000 per transaction, forbid cash withdrawals, and need reconciliation within seven days of month end.
